analysis:
Examined head_text of ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift lines 619-1569, which is unchanged context. The range map is complete: the only changed lines are 135 and 513. Both swap autopilotAllowsModel for autopilotServesModel in admission gates: throwIfRefusingNewLocalWork, and the authoritative pre-registration check that returns 503 capacity.

The semantics of autopilotServesModel are not in the supplied evidence. Integration should confirm it is at least as strict as autopilotAllowsModel for managed network work, i.e. it does not admit models outside the autopilot selection. This is availability/routing policy only. It is not an authorization or attestation gate under TB-011/T-053, which remain coordinator-enforced.

The visible streaming path keeps the T-008 fail-closed encryption behavior. precomputeSharedKey failure (lines 800-815) and encryptPayloadFast failure (lines 823-843) both send an encryptionFailure terminal and abort. No plaintext chunk is sent: data is "" with encryptedData at line 852.

Billing floors (lines 1445-1488) and the hash domain (lines 1166-1205) are unchanged. Cache usage reporting is gated on remoteCache.scope (line 1524), consistent with T-041 scope plumbing.

ProviderLoop+MTPUpgrade.swift adds transitionGenerations.begin(.modelLoading) at head line 127, right after isLoadingAny=true. This appears to mark a model-loading transition generation so that capacity/advertisement evidence is invalidated during an MTP upgrade load. The unit metadata-only entry (:0) has no content.

There is no matching end/complete call visible. Integration should verify that the transition generation is closed or superseded on all exit paths, including defer and errors. Otherwise the provider could be stuck advertising a loading state, which is availability only.

No security regression identified from the visible evidence.
